gloss: second rank; stylish; thanks for the hard work (internet slang)

definitions.gloss: second (in a sequence); B; the second of the ten Heavenly Stems
definitions.explanation: The second item in the traditional East Asian ordering system (the Heavenly Stems). Used to label items as 'B' in contracts, forms, and legal documents.

definitions.gloss: stylish; tasteful; chic; having a certain charm
definitions.explanation: Describes something that has a subtle, refined elegance or charm. Often used for experiences, places, or things that are pleasantly understated.

definitions.gloss: thanks for the hard work (internet slang)
definitions.explanation: Short for お{疲|つか}れ (otsukaresama), used online to express thanks or acknowledgment, especially at the end of a gaming session or collaborative work.

notes:
A word with a remarkably wide range of uses, from formal legal documents to casual internet slang.

SENSE 1 — RANKING:
Part of the {十干|じっかん} (Heavenly Stems) system: {甲|こう}, {乙|おつ}, ⟦{丙|へい}→丙：18072_hei⟧, {丁|てい}... Used in contracts where {甲|こう} is Party A and {乙|おつ} is Party B.

SENSE 2 — STYLISH:
{乙|おつ}な is a somewhat old-fashioned but still-used expression describing understated elegance. Common set phrases:
- {乙|おつ}な⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: a sophisticated flavor
- {乙|おつ}なもの: something with charm
- {乙|おつ}な{計|はか}らい: a thoughtful, tasteful arrangement

SENSE 3 — INTERNET SLANG:
Abbreviation of お⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧ (otsukaresama). Written in hiragana (おつ) or katakana (オツ). Very common in live streams, gaming, and online communities.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{粋|いき}→粋：13773_iki⟧: stylish, chic — the Edo aesthetic sense; more strongly cultural
- {甲|こう}: first rank, A — the counterpart to {乙|おつ} in ranking
